_comment: Copy to secrets.json (gitignored) to bake credentials into a build. scripts/copy-static.js copies it into dist/ and src/config.ts reads it as the default for users who have not supplied their own. NEVER commit the real file: this repository is public, GitHub push protection will reject it, and anything that slips through gets scraped and revoked.
_googleClientId: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 'Desktop app' client id. Not secret in itself (RFC 8252), but kept here next to its secret. A default ships in src/config.ts.
_aiKeys: Optional. Without them the app routes AI calls through the relay, or asks for keys in Settings.
_databaseUrl: Optional. Shared remote Postgres for zero-setup cross-machine workspace collaboration. Without it, each install falls back to its own embedded local Postgres and can't join workspaces created elsewhere. NEVER put this literal in config.ts (source, public) — that's what leaked the v1.1.9 DB password.
